figures.public_caption: Panel a shows a schematic of the evaporation-induced interfacial assembly and transfer process. Panel b illustrates film transfer to the photonic crystal cavity using a picking process, forming a monolayer with QDs in close contact. Panel c depicts the lifting process, where QDs are spaced 20–50 nm from the photonic crystal surface. AFM images in panel d compare the surface topography of the vapor-side and water-side interfaces, each scanned at 250 × 250 nm.

figures.public_caption: Panel a shows an SEM image of a photonic crystal device before coating with a PbS-P3HT composite monolayer film. Panel b shows the same device after coating. Panel c presents a TEM image of the PbS-P3HT monolayer. Panel d shows an SEM image of a freely suspended monolayer over a corner feature, used to monitor the monolayer's optical properties.

figures.public_caption: Photoluminescence spectra compare quantum-dot cavity assemblies made by picking and lifting transfers with a freestanding PbS–P3HT layer. The second panel presents the enhanced Ey resonance of a polystyrene-containing L3 cavity, including an inset recorded at higher spectral resolution.
